narr: Storms developed along a stationary boundary in northwestern Oklahoma into the Texas panhandle during the afternoon and evening of the 31st. Slow storm motions led to very heavy rainfall and flooding in some locations. Intense winds close to 80 mph, large hail, and a few tornadoes were also reported.
ev: Some roads covered with water, stalled vehicles reported.
Some streets reported impassible due to flood water.
lsr: SOME ROADS COVERED WITH WATER, STALLED VEHICLES.
